title: Gem Mint 10- 2021 Panini Phoenix - Fire Burst #12 Stefon Diggs
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The Gem Mint 10-2021 Panini Phoenix Fire Burst #12 Stefon Diggs trading card is a highly sought-after collectible featuring the wide receiver for the Buffalo Bills in the National Football League. Manufactured by Panini, this sports trading card is part of the 2021 Panini Phoenix set and showcases a unique Fire Burst parallel variety. This limited edition card is a valuable addition to any sports memorabilia collection, especially for fans of Stefon Diggs and the Buffalo Bills.
